description: This file defines the JmsTopicListener class, which is responsible for listening to JMS topic messages in an Apache OFBiz framework module. It manages JMS connection setup, message subscription, and cleanup.

classes.name: JmsTopicListener
classes.description: A JMS message listener for a specific topic, handling connection setup and message subscription within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JmsTopicListener
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the listener with JMS and JNDI parameters.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the JMS session and connection, handling exceptions appropriately.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Establishes JMS connection, creates session, looks up the topic, subscribes to messages, and starts listening.
